payload.primary_text: 請你把這本書放在桌子上吧。
payload.transliteration: Qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè běn shū fàng zài zhuōzi shàng ba.
payload.translation: Please put this book on the table.
payload.cloze_text: 請你把這本書放在桌子上____。
payload.target_breakdown: 吧 (ba) - modal particle used to make a polite suggestion

payload.primary_text: 王先生今天穿了一件白色的衣服。
payload.transliteration: Wáng xiānsheng jīntiān chuānle yī jiàn báisè de yīfu.
payload.translation: Mr. Wang is wearing a white piece of clothing today.
payload.cloze_text: 王先生今天穿了一件____色的衣服。
payload.target_breakdown: 白 (bái) - white; appears in 白色 (white-colored)

payload.primary_text: 這家商店裡有三百多本漢語書。
payload.transliteration: Zhè jiā shāngdiàn lǐ yǒu sān bǎi duō běn Hànyǔ shū.
payload.translation: There are more than three hundred Chinese books in this shop.
payload.cloze_text: 這家商店裡有____多本漢語書。
payload.target_breakdown: 百 (bǎi) - hundred; 三百 (three hundred)

payload.primary_text: 醫生說幫助病人是他最重要的工作。
payload.transliteration: Yīshēng shuō bāngzhù bìngrén shì tā zuì zhòngyào de gōngzuò.
payload.translation: The doctor says helping patients is his most important job.
payload.cloze_text: 醫生說____病人是他最重要的工作。
payload.target_breakdown: 幫助 (bāngzhù) - to help / to assist

payload.primary_text: 我爸爸每天早上都看報紙。
payload.transliteration: Wǒ bàba měitiān zǎoshang dōu kàn bàozhǐ.
payload.translation: My father reads the newspaper every morning.
payload.target_breakdown: 報紙 (bàozhǐ) - newspaper

payload.translation: My older sister is taller than me.
payload.target_breakdown: 比 (bǐ) - than; used in comparisons

payload.primary_text: 媽媽說別在桌子上寫字。
payload.transliteration: Māmā shuō bié zài zhuōzi shàng xiě zì.
payload.translation: Mother says don't write on the table.
payload.target_breakdown: 別 (bié) - don't; prohibitive adverb

payload.primary_text: 這條路很長,我們坐出租車去吧。
payload.transliteration: Zhè tiáo lù hěn cháng, wǒmen zuò chūzūchē qù ba.
payload.translation: This road is very long; let's take a taxi.
payload.cloze_text: 這條路很____,我們坐出租車去吧。
payload.target_breakdown: 長 (cháng) - long

payload.primary_text: 我很高興能和你一起唱歌。
payload.transliteration: Wǒ hěn gāoxìng néng hé nǐ yīqǐ chànggē.
payload.translation: I am very glad to be able to sing with you.
payload.target_breakdown: 唱歌 (chànggē) - to sing (songs)

payload.primary_text: 明天上午我們要出去買東西。
payload.transliteration: Míngtiān shàngwǔ wǒmen yào chūqù mǎi dōngxi.
payload.translation: Tomorrow morning we are going out to buy things.
payload.cloze_text: 明天上午我們要____去買東西。
payload.target_breakdown: 出 (chū) - to go out; 出去 (to go out)

payload.translation: This is my book.
payload.target_breakdown: 的 indicates possession, linking '我' (I) to '書' (book), meaning 'my'.

payload.translation: I go to school today.
payload.target_breakdown: 我 is the first-person singular pronoun meaning 'I'.

payload.translation: Can you speak Chinese?
payload.target_breakdown: 你 is the second-person singular pronoun meaning 'you'.

payload.translation: He is a teacher.
payload.target_breakdown: 是 is the copula verb meaning 'to be', linking subject and predicate.

payload.translation: I read the book.
payload.target_breakdown: 了 indicates a completed action, marking that the action of reading the book is finished.

payload.translation: I do not like tea.
payload.target_breakdown: 不 is a negator meaning 'not', negating the verb 喜歡.

payload.translation: He is studying now.
payload.target_breakdown: 在 indicates an action in progress, showing that the subject is currently studying.

payload.translation: He has a son.
payload.target_breakdown: 他 is the third-person singular masculine pronoun meaning 'he'.

payload.translation: We will go to school tomorrow.
payload.target_breakdown: 我們 is the first-person plural pronoun meaning 'we'.

payload.translation: The weather is very good.
payload.target_breakdown: 好 is an adjective meaning 'good', describing the weather.
